questions.explanation: Distance covered by Alto in 10 days = 10 days × 10 L/day × 25 km/L = 2500 km. Speed of Alto = 2500 / 50 = 50 km/h. Distance covered by Tiago = 10 × 12 × 30 = 3600 km. Speed of Tiago = 3600 / 50 = 72 km/h. Ratio = 50 : 72 = 25 : 36.

questions.hindiQuestion: ऑल्टो और क्विड 10 दिनों की अपनी औसत गति से एक-दूसरे की ओर यात्रा करते हैं। यदि प्रारंभिक दूरी 2,300 किमी है, तो मिलने के बाद एक-दूसरे के शुरुआती बिंदु तक पहुँचने में दोनों द्वारा लिए गए समय का अंतर क्या है?
questions.explanation: Speed of Alto = (10 × 10 × 25) / 50 = 50 km/h. Distance covered by Kwid = 10 × 20 × 25 = 5000 km, speed = 5000 / 100 = 50 km/h. Since both cars travel at exactly the same speed (50 km/h), each takes identical time to cover the remaining distance after meeting. Difference = 0 hours.

questions.question: If the male population above the poverty line in State C is 1.5 million, what is State C's total population?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य C में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर पुरुषों की जनसंख्या 1.5 मिलियन है, तो राज्य C की कुल जनसंख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: In State C, % above poverty line = 75%. Ratio of M : F above poverty line = 2 : 3. Male fraction = 2/5 of 75% = 30% of total population. If 30% = 1.5 million, Total population = 1.5 / 0.30 = 5 million.

questions.question: What is the number of females above the poverty line in State D if its population is 7 million?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य D की जनसंख्या 7 मिलियन है, तो राज्य D में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर महिलाओं की संख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: Population above poverty line in State D = 80% of 7 million = 5.6 million. Female fraction = 3 / (4 + 3) = 3/7. Females above poverty line = (3/7) × 5.6 = 2.4 million.

questions.question: What is the approximate male population above the poverty line in State A if the female population below the poverty line is 1.8 million?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य A में गरीबी रेखा से नीचे महिलाओं की जनसंख्या 1.8 मिलियन है, तो राज्य A में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर पुरुषों की अनुमानित जनसंख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: Females below poverty line in A = 6/11 of Below-poverty population = 1.8 M => Below-poverty population = 1.8 × 11 / 6 = 3.3 million. Since below poverty line is 30%, Total population = 3.3 / 0.30 = 11 million. Population above poverty line (70%) = 7.7 million. Males above = 6/13 × 7.7 million ≈ 3.5538 million ≈ 3.55 million.
questions.verificationNote: Stem corrected: The original question printed 'above' the poverty line where 'below' was required to match the calculation: Female below = 1.8M => Total = 11M => Male above = 7.7 × 6/13 ≈ 3.55 M.

questions.question: If males below the poverty line number 2.4 million in State B and 6 million in State E, what is the ratio of the total populations of States B and E?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य B में गरीबी रेखा से नीचे पुरुषों की संख्या 2.4 मिलियन है और राज्य E में 6 मिलियन है, तो राज्य B और E की कुल जनसंख्या का अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation: In B: Males below = (3/8) × 0.20 × Pop(B) = 0.075 Pop(B) = 2.4 M => Pop(B) = 2.4 / 0.075 = 32 million. In E: Males below = (5/8) × 0.15 × Pop(E) = 0.09375 Pop(E) = 6 M => Pop(E) = 6 / 0.09375 = 64 million. Ratio Pop(B) : Pop(E) = 32 : 64 = 1 : 2.

questions.question: If State C has a total population of 4 million, how many females are above the poverty line?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य C की कुल जनसंख्या 4 मिलियन है, तो गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर महिलाओं की संख्या कितनी है?

questions.question: What are the approximate average marks obtained by all seven students in English?
questions.hindiQuestion: सभी सात छात्रों द्वारा अंग्रेजी (अधिकतम 120) में प्राप्त अनुमानित औसत अंक क्या हैं?
questions.explanation: English max marks = 120. Percentages: 50, 85, 70, 65, 90, 80, 80. Sum of percentages = 520%. Average percentage = 520 / 7 ≈ 74.285%. Average marks = 74.285% of 120 = 89.14 ≈ 89.

questions.question: How many students obtained 60% and above marks in all subjects?

questions.explanation: Inspecting each student's percentages: Ankit has Maths 35% (<60%); Brijesh has Hindi 50% (<60%); Chirag: 90, 60, 70, 70, 90, 70 (all >= 60%); Divyesh has Hindi 40% (<60%); Ehan has Maths 50% (<60%); Faruk has Biology 40% (<60%); Gautam: 80, 65, 80, 80, 60, 60 (all >= 60%). Exactly 2 students (Chirag and Gautam) scored >= 60% in all subjects.

questions.hindiQuestion: किस विषय में समग्र (overall) प्रतिशत सबसे कम है?
questions.explanation: Sum of percentages across the 7 students: Maths has the lowest sum (35 + 65 + 60 + 75 + 50 + 80 + 65 = 430%), making its overall average percentage lowest among the choices.

questions.question: What is Brijesh's approximate overall percentage?
questions.hindiQuestion: बृजेश का अनुमानित समग्र प्रतिशत क्या है?
questions.explanation: Total marks scored by Brijesh = 120 + 84.5 + 102 + 95 + 30 + 36 = 467.5. Total maximum marks = 150 + 130 + 120 + 100 + 60 + 40 = 600. Overall percentage = (467.5 / 600) × 100 ≈ 77.92% ≈ 78%.

questions.explanation: Consumption in 2020 = Production + Import − Export: Afghanistan = 2100 + 400 − 600 = 1900. Bangladesh = 1400 + 300 − 400 = 1300. Bhutan = 2000 + 400 − 800 = 1600.
